standard_prerequisites.use: Approximation and descent of spaces and morphisms of finite presentation (Limits of Spaces, proposition-approximate, lemmas descend-separated, descend-finite-presentation, descend-separated-morphism, topology-limit), the schemes-level Chow input and the H-projectivity criteria from the Morphisms chapter (projective-over-quasi-projective-is-H-projective, H-projective-composition); cited inputs with the reduction and diagram construction written in the retained span.

core_obligations: Reduce to a base of finite type over Spec(Z) via directed limits and descent of X and the generic points of X.
Construct the Noetherian auxiliary diagram whose blowup X' maps to a projective space.
Prove the relevant closed subspace Z' is H-projective over Spec(Z) using O_{P^n}(1).
Deduce the diagonal X' -> P^m_Y is an immersion because its composite with the projection to P^m over Z is one.

proof_roadmap.step: Noetherian approximation reduces the base to finite type over Z.
Descend the generic-point data and build the projective ambient space.
H-projectivity of Z' over Z yields a closed immersion into P^m_Z.
The diagonal into P^m_Y is an immersion; the blowup is U-admissible.

difficulty_reason: For a separated finite type morphism f : X -> Y of algebraic spaces over a scheme S with Y separated and Noetherian, there is a U-admissible blowup X' -> X for some dense open U in X and an immersion X' -> P^n_Y. The retained proof is a full multi-paragraph argument: it first reduces via absolute Noetherian approximation to the case where Y is of finite type over Spec(Z), writing Y as a directed limit of separated finite type spaces and descending X and the generic-point configuration to a finite stage; it then builds a commutative diagram over a Noetherian base with a projective ambient space, closes out by equipping an auxiliary closed subspace Z with the very ample sheaf O_{P^n}(1), concluding Z' -> Z is H-projective, hence Z' -> Spec(Z) is H-projective and admits a closed immersion into P^m over Z, and finally verifies the diagonal X' -> P^m_Y is an immersion. Retained author proof at lines 9292-9365.
